definitions.gloss: prelude; introduction (of a piece of music)
definitions.explanation: The instrumental passage played before the singing or main part of a piece begins.

examples.japanese: {前奏|ぜんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前奏|ぜんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: This song has a long introduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前奏|ぜんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{合唱|がっしょう}→合唱：04900_gasshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Following the piano introduction, the choir quietly began.

notes:
The standard, somewhat formal term used in music education, school choirs and hymn books. In pop music talk ⟦イントロ→イントロ：30028_intoro⟧ is the everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前奏|ぜんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧: the introduction plays
- {前奏|ぜんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧: to play the introduction
- {前奏|ぜんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: following the introduction

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦イントロ→イントロ：30028_intoro⟧: intro (everyday, pop music)
- {間奏|かんそう}: interlude between verses
- {後奏|こうそう}: postlude, closing passage
